name: M. K. Stalin
role: DMK president (since 2018); Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2021–2026)
summary: Stalin leads the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam and served as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu from 2021 to 2026. As CM he emphasised state autonomy against the Union government, opposed Hindi and NEET, and expanded women's cash and school-meal schemes; his party lost the 2026 election.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Declared an all-out war on the illegal sale of drugs, launched the "Tamil Nadu Without Drugs" campaign with an oath against use and sale, and promised tougher laws and special courts.

decide-locally.rationale: State autonomy against the Union is nearby; no stated position on deciding as locally as possible in general.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The manifesto of the party he leads pledges carbon neutrality by 2050, climate education and climate models for India; it does not describe the scale as drastic.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Courting private investment is nearby; no stated position on the state directing investment.

separate-church-state.rationale: Describes his government as secular and protecting all religions, but funds temple renovation and consecration programmes (5,000 temples pledged in 2026).

direct-action.rationale: Threatening one agitation while governing through elections is nearby; no stated position on direct action over elections.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: His government's Assembly resolution (moved by him) called the Citizenship (Amendment) Act contrary to the secular principles of the Constitution, and the manifesto of the party he leads states that the Constitution asserts equality before the law for everyone and pledges to remove the Governors' immunity from legal action.

reviewHistory.rationale: Handed temple priest appointment orders to non-Brahmin trainees in 2021, citing Periyar's demand for equal rights in worship for all believers.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Wrote to the Law Commission that Tamil Nadu is firmly against a Uniform Civil Code, which he said would challenge the diverse social structure and could not be introduced without the consent of religious communities; the party manifesto he led says the UCC "will not be implemented".

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Arrested in 1976 under the Emergency and, in his autobiography, calls the jail time a "torture camp"; he treats the Emergency's arrests and curtailment of liberties as wrong, not as a tool against internal enemies.

reviewHistory.rationale: Jailed in 1976 under MISA for protesting the Emergency; record of opposing emergency rule.
reviewHistory.author: claude-haiku-5-5

minority-language-support.rationale: The manifesto of the party he leads pledges equal funding for all state languages, Union exams in Tamil and other state languages, and Tamil as a co-official language in Union offices in Tamil Nadu; his 2022 letter sought Eighth Schedule languages' equal footing.

central-bank-independence.rationale: The manifesto of the party he leads says the Reserve Bank, with the Supreme Court, CAG, Election Commission and others, should operate autonomously and without political interference.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Objected to a Kudankulam spent-fuel storage plan in 2022, citing accidents at similar facilities elsewhere and public concern before the risk was resolved.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Autonomy within the Union is nearby; no stated position on a region keeping its own legal and economic system.

refugee-return.rationale: The manifesto of the party he leads pledges citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamil refugees in Tamil Nadu and all necessary assistance to those who wish to return to Sri Lanka.

paid-care-work.rationale: Launching the Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Rs 1,000 a month to women) he spoke of the invisible labour of stay-at-home mothers that society dismisses and said the scheme is "one step towards compensating this labour".

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Announced a state-funded Tamil Nadu Assured Pension Scheme (50% of last-drawn basic pay, with dearness allowance) to replace the contributory scheme, calling it comparable to the old pension scheme; this keeps a state pension rather than moving to individual accounts.

reviewHistory.rationale: Pledged restoration of the Old Pension Scheme in 2021 and introduced an assured pension scheme in 2026, rather than market-managed individual accounts.

single-official-language.rationale: Opposed Hindi imposition as impractical, divisive and against federal principles, and asked that all Eighth Schedule languages, including Tamil, have equal rights (letter to Modi, 16 Oct 2022).

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: The manifesto of the party he leads pledges to amend the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act so that foreign aid to NGOs keeps reaching them without problems, and objects to the funding having been stopped.

job-guarantee.rationale: Wrote to the Prime Minister defending MGNREGA as a rights-based, demand-driven employment guarantee, and the manifesto of the party he leads pledges 150 days a year, Rs 400 a day and a similar Urban Employment Scheme law.

socialized-care.rationale: Publicly run childcare centres are nearby; no stated position on housework and childcare as public services.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Citizen request platforms are nearby; no stated position on direct participation in decisions.

dynastic-succession.rationale: As chief minister he had his son Udhayanidhi made deputy chief minister in 2024, which the report calls making him heir apparent in the DMK; he succeeded his own father as DMK president in 2018. This is the party and the deputy post, not a handover of state power.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: His government opened priest-training schools to women and three women completed the archaka course; he called it a new era of inclusivity and equality. This covers temple priesthood only, not every religious office.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Expanding public services is nearby; no stated position on keeping essentials in public hands.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Argued that Centre action on delimitation is a direct assault on states' rights and that state powers need protection; the specific constitutional-safeguard position is contested in coverage.

farm-price-support.rationale: 2026 manifesto pledged higher paddy and sugarcane procurement prices and free pump sets for farmers.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Asked India to press for an ICC referral of Sri Lankan leaders over war crimes at the UN Human Rights Council (letter to Modi, 27 Jan 2021).

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Asked India to press Sri Lanka to implement the 13th Amendment for Sri Lankan Tamils and to protect their rights (letters of 2021 and 2026).

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Women's stipend is means-tested by household income, land and electricity use, while the breakfast scheme in government schools is universal; the record points both ways.

notes: Office: CM until 9 May 2026 (succeeded by C. Joseph Vijay); defeated in Kolathur in 2026. Many statements (economy, ideology, most social issues) have no recorded position. Sanatana remarks in 2023 were by his son Udhayanidhi and are not attributed to him. Caste reservation quotas and NEET stance are documented but no matching statement exists in the list, except as noted. Pass 2 (2026-11-23) added the 2024 DMK manifesto, his letters on the UCC and MGNREGA, and records on the CAA resolution, drug campaign, women priests, pension scheme and succession. Themes searched: economy and welfare (pensions, jobs, taxes, wages, GST), government and federalism (Governors, Article 356, finances, delimitation), society (women, caste, priests, drugs), culture and language, world (Sri Lanka, UN), ecology, mining and nuclear; Gaza and Iran (he condemned the Israeli bombing of Gaza and strikes on Iran and asked India to press for a ceasefire, but no statement in the list matches those remarks); most remaining statements (markets, ideology, war, revolution, technology, sexuality) have no recorded position. The 2021 manifesto and his autobiography could not be read in full.
